slides.title: Pudu Robotics Unveils PuduFM 1.0 and PuduAgent
slides.tldr: NEW HUMANOID AND EMBODIED AI SYSTEMS
slides.highlight: The introduction of PuduFM 1.0 and PuduAgent advances humanoid and embodied AI systems, providing relevant insights for RwB's focus on embodied social robots.

slides.title: Is Telehealth Better Used to Treat Patients or Help Other Physicians Treat Patients? An Agent-Based Modeling Study of Healthcare Provision
slides.highlight: This study uses agent-based modeling to analyze how physician-to-physician versus physician-to-patient telehealth affects clinical outcomes and system utilization, aligning with MIMIC's focus on societal-scale simulation and impact analysis.

card.one_liner: Telehealth is more cost-effective for toxicologist-physician consultations than for direct toxicologist-patient care.
card.key_idea: An agent-based model simulating medical toxicology care to compare health outcomes and costs across physician-physician, physician-patient, and poison control center access points.
card.evaluation: Simulated 1,000 patients and 100 physicians across 100 runs; results were validated against existing empirical cost-savings data for poison control centers.
card.limitation: Relies on simulated data and an incomplete model that assumes perfect in-hospital diagnostic accuracy and single medical problems per patient.

slides.title: Modelling Opinion Dynamics at Scale with Deep MARL
slides.highlight: This research uses multi-agent reinforcement learning to simulate opinion dynamics and conformity in large social networks, aligning with MIMIC's focus on societal-scale simulation of human-AI societies.

card.one_liner: Deep MARL models opinion dynamics to show how conformity in large social networks promotes misinformation.
card.key_idea: A GPU-accelerated consensus and truth-finding game using general-sum other-play MARL and a learned attention layer to recover agent importance from graph topology.
card.evaluation: Validated on a Bluesky network subset; compared large social media networks against small hunter-gatherer networks regarding collective accuracy and conformity.

slides.title: Personality Anchoring for Social Simulation: Linking Personality, Social Behavior, and Interaction Success with LLM Agents
slides.tldr: PERSONALITY ANCHORING FOR LLM SOCIAL SIMULATION
slides.highlight: This research introduces personality anchoring to simulate how dyadic personality traits influence social behavior and goal achievement, supporting MIMIC's focus on LLM-based agent models for societal-scale simulation.

card.one_liner: High dyadic Agreeableness significantly increases shared goal achievement in LLM-based social simulations via cooperative strategies.
card.key_idea: Personality anchoring leverages LLMs' internal knowledge of well-known characters to simulate personality-consistent behavior without explicit trait prompting, using a structured taxonomy of human goals.
card.evaluation: 1,010 conversations across 7 goal categories. Evaluated via LLM-as-a-judge for goal achievement and ICC for consistency (0.89). Results were replicated with Mistral Large.
card.limitation: Relies on LLM-as-a-judge scoring and pre-existing character knowledge, which may introduce stereotypical biases and lack cultural diversity.

slides.title: UBTECH launches UWORLD U1 humanoid robot companions
slides.highlight: The launch of UWORLD U1 humanoid robot companions is relevant to RwB's focus on embodied social robots.

slides.title: Personalized and Robust Proactive Robot Assistance with Uncertainty-Guided LLM Reasoning
slides.tldr: PROACTIVE ROBOT ASSISTANCE VIA UNCERTAINTY-GUIDED LLM REASONING
slides.highlight: The GLOBE framework improves proactive robot assistance in noisy household environments by combining Markov models with LLM reasoning. This is relevant to RwB's focus on human-robot interaction and embodied AI.

card.one_liner: GLOBE uses n-gram Markov models and selective LLM reasoning for robust, proactive household object prediction.
card.key_idea: Combines lightweight n-gram Markov models for temporal patterns with an LLM that is selectively triggered via a confidence threshold to resolve prediction uncertainty.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on HOMER+ and a new HOMER-Noise dataset (simulating human/pet/toddler disturbances) using F1-scores; compared against SLaTe-PRO and STOT.
card.limitation: Inference latency is significantly higher than baselines due to external LLM API calls.

slides.title: Safe, Fluent and Acceptable Motion Generation and Execution for Human--Robot Interaction in Manufacturing Environments
slides.tldr: SOCIALLY-AWARE MOTION CONTROL FOR HUMAN-ROBOT INTERACTION
slides.highlight: This research explores integrating social-aware motion control and psycho-cognitive perspectives into robot behavior to improve social acceptability. It is relevant to RwB's focus on human-robot interaction and embodied social robots.

card.one_liner: A motion control framework that generates socially-aware robot behaviors by modulating velocity and interaction distance.
card.key_idea: An MPC framework using separating-plane optimization and LSTM-based human motion prediction to implement four distinct behaviors based on maximum velocity and interaction distance parameters.
card.evaluation: Validated via a user study with 111 non-experts using NASA-TLX and 10 bipolar adjective scales; results showed significant impacts on social perception.
card.limitation: Interaction distance had minimal significant effect on most perceptual dimensions compared to the strong influence of velocity profiles.

slides.title: Titans-as-a-Layer: Test-Time Memory for Conversational Speech Emotion Recognition
slides.highlight: This work introduces a Memory-as-a-Layer adapter to capture dialogue history and emotional context, supporting HyECHO's focus on multimodal social perception and engagement.

card.one_liner: Introduces a plug-and-play memory adapter to capture dialogue context for conversational speech emotion recognition.
card.key_idea: A Memory-as-a-Layer (MAL) adapter using Titans-style neural memory provides audio-token-aligned residual updates to frozen LALMs, trained sequentially after LoRA task adaptation.
card.evaluation: Tested on IEMOCAP, MELD, and MultiDialog using Qwen2-Audio, Audio Flamingo 3, and Ultravox-v0.4; showed consistent improvements in WA, UA, and WF1.
card.limitation: Further validation across more backbone-dataset combinations and comparisons with other memory architectures are needed.

slides.title: Impedance MPC for Physical Human-Robot Interaction: Predictive Disturbance Rejection with Joint-Limit Safety
slides.tldr: IMPROVED COMPLIANT SAFETY AND ACCURACY IN pHRI
slides.highlight: This work introduces a two-layer Impedance MPC that achieves zero steady-state error under sustained human force while ensuring joint-limit safety, supporting the development of embodied social robots in RwB.

card.one_liner: A two-layer Impedance MPC achieving zero steady-state error and joint-limit safety for physical human-robot interaction.
card.key_idea: Analytical feedforward cancellation reduces the robot to a constant-state linear double integrator, enabling a fast convex QP with Kalman-augmented disturbance estimation.
card.evaluation: Tested on a 7-DOF Franka FR3 in MuJoCo; outperformed classical impedance with <0.05mm steady-state error under 15N force and sub-millimeter tracking.
card.limitation: Zero-steady-state-error guarantee applies only to constant or asymptotically constant disturbances; anti-windup under persistent saturation is not fully proven.

slides.title: Ouvia: A User-centered Framework for Measuring Usability of Speech Translation in Real-World Communication Scenarios
slides.highlight: Ouvia provides a framework for measuring the usability of speech translation in real-world one-to-one communication, supporting HyECHO's focus on multimodal social perception and listener modeling.

card.one_liner: Ouvia is a user-centered framework measuring the real-world usability of speech translation across diverse demographics.
card.key_idea: A multi-phase protocol involving senders, receivers, and bilingual validators to assess if translations effectively convey key information in healthcare and everyday scenarios.
card.evaluation: 1,738 interactions across four ST systems with speakers of three English dialects. Found QA-based metrics predict usability better than standard automatic metrics.
card.limitation: Limited to one language pair (English-Portuguese) using clean, scripted speech recorded in noise-free environments, potentially overestimating real-world usability.

slides.title: Agentic Neuro-Symbolic Planning and Commissioning for Human-in-the-Loop Industrial Robotics with Digital Twins
slides.tldr: AGENTIC NEURO-SYMBOLIC FRAMEWORK FOR INDUSTRIAL ROBOTICS
slides.highlight: This work introduces a neuro-symbolic architecture combining LLMs with deterministic verification for human-in-the-loop robotics, aligning with MIMIC's focus on neuro-symbolic and LLM-based agent models.

card.one_liner: A neuro-symbolic framework for industrial robotics combining LLMs for reasoning with deterministic symbolic verification and digital twins.
card.key_idea: An SDI (Specifier-Designer-Inspector) architecture using LLMs for language/design and symbolic agents for physical constraint verification, integrated with a Unity3D digital twin for human oversight.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on natural-language commands across multiple difficulty levels against ten baselines; achieved the highest task success rate.
